Subject: Logging controls & redaction - post-call follow-up

Hi Alex

Great to meet earlier



- You want to capture request/response logs for debugging and analytics but must ensure PII (account numbers, SSNs, payment tokens) are never stored in plaintext.
- Need options for retention (30/90/365 days) per environment and the ability to configure redaction/masking rules per route.
- Headers and trace IDs: you need correlation ids preserved for tracing but want any sensitive header values redacted.
- Data residency: production logs must be stored in us-east-1 only.

What Redwood can offer (high-level):
- Configurable logging profiles per model/route with multi-stage redaction (client-side, gateway, and storage-layer).
- Default PII redaction rules (SSN, credit card numbers, emails) plus custom regex rules you can provide.
- Request/response hashing for non-deterministic tokens and optional deterministic masking for troubleshooting.
- Per-tenant retention controls and region pinning for log storage.
- Audit trail for redaction rule changes and exportable redaction snapshots.

Attachments: redwood_logging_controls_one-pager.pdf

Proposed next steps:
1) You to share the security questionnaire and any example log lines with PII (sanitized)

2) Schedule a 60-minute tech deep-dive with your infra/security + our infra/serving team (suggested attendees below).
3) We'll produce a redaction config draft and retention proposal for your review within 3 business days after the call.

Suggested attendees:
- From FintechCo: Alex (product), security rep, infra/ops lead
- From Redwood: Rishi (AE), Dev (infra engineer), Marissa (solutions)

Would you be able to share the security questionnaire and a couple of sample log snippets (sanitized) by EOD Wednesday? I attached a short one-pager that outlines our logging controls and typical redaction patterns.

Thanks

Best,
